name: Marie & Line Clinic (마리앤라인의원)
desc: MUST GO — BEST PROFILE MATCH. ADDED (not from Instagram) — surfaced from Korean-language sources. The only clinic found anywhere built around LOW-IRRITATION management of sensitive skin: seborrheic and contact dermatitis, rosacea, inflammatory acne, compromised barrier. Explicitly avoids aggressive modalities, uses LDM, U-Cell and RF instead. That is your presenting problem described almost exactly. 130 Daehak-ro, 5F (McDonald's building), Hyehwa Stn Exit 1. Tel 02-718-8000. TRADE-OFF: non-Gangnam, Korean-language practice — assume Korean-only and plan an interpreter or translation app. VERIFY before booking: confirm a 피부과 전문의 (board-certified dermatology specialist) practises there.

name: Remember Dermatology Yaksu (리멤버피부과 약수역점)
desc: MUST GO IF ROSACEA — CONTINGENT. ADDED from Korean-language sources. Positions specifically around 홍조/주사 (flushing and rosacea) with board-certified staff stated. THIS IS THE BRANCH CLINIC: if the week-1 consult comes back rosacea-pattern vascular rather than irritant barrier damage, this is where you go. If it comes back irritant, skip it. 128-1 Dasan-ro, 5F, Yaksu Stn. Tel 02-2234-7575. Mon/Wed/Thu 10-19, Tue/Fri 10-20, Sat 10-15. Central non-luxury location suggests local pricing. VERIFY before booking.

name: Leaders Dermatology Apgujeong (리더스피부과 압구정점)
desc: MUST GO — STRONGEST CREDENTIALS. ADDED from Korean-language sources. One director is Vice President of the Korean Dermatological Association, the other a top board-exam scorer; both Seoul National University trained. Dedicated pigment laser systems (Eraser multi-toning, RevLite SI, Helios 785). If you want the pigment question — 72 pimple marks, pigmentation 54, freckles 49, pigmentary-severe dark circles — answered by someone who helps set the national standard, this is the address. 843 Eonju-ro, Apgujeong Stn. Tel 1588-7833. Prices not published. VERIFY credentials and get a written quote.

name: Reberry Clinic Gangnam (리베리의원 강남점)
desc: MUST GO AS PRICE BENCHMARK. ADDED from Korean-language sources. Publishes a full Korean-language price list — this is why it anchors the local baselines in the assessment. Pico toning 150,000 KRW/session, dual toning 259,000, five-session packages from 990,000, Rejuran 2cc 180,000, Thermage FLX 600 shots 1,990,000, Ultherapy 300 lines 1,290,000. USE THIS EVEN IF YOU NEVER BOOK: it is your reference point for whether another clinic's quote is fair. Also has a Myeongdong branch at similar pricing. Note Korean clinics run heavy event pricing, so treat as order-of-magnitude.
